project.name: @kawase/mobile
project.productType: AI-agent money app on Arc (Circle L1): the agent is the front door, screens are add-ons (D37)

direction.name: Senryo
direction.summary: Senryo's look exactly (D40): light-first neutrals (#F5F5F5 ground, white cards, #ECECEC insets), black primary actions, #FA00FF magenta with black labels only for trade, publish, selected controls and the focus ring, up/down only for direction, Inter for the interface and Roboto Condensed Black for money and page titles. Testnet is neutral plates plus the mode capsule, never a hue wash.

built.name: Button
built.port: Senryo port: 56 pt plate (44 compact), 28/22 radius, black primary, quiet secondary one step lighter than its ground, ghost in link ink, destructive on its wash; 0.97 press scale (100/160 ms) and a press haptic.
built.deviations: No outline/border on content (Senryo rule); the 21st button is the API spec (variants, loading), the anatomy is Senryo's.

built.name: Surface (Panel, SectionLabel, KeyValue, Rule, SurfaceLevel)

source.composedFrom: Senryo kit/Surface.tsx (no 21st card fits: every 21st card carries a border or a shadow)

built.port: Depth is one step lighter fill per level (card on a page, raised-2 in a sheet); 20 pt corners; no border, no shadow.

built.name: ListRow
built.port: Leading real mark, title, detail, chevron or trailing control; rows separated by height, not lines; pressed row fill; tick haptic.

built.name: Segmented
built.port: Sliding plate on a 170 ms curve, radio semantics, tick per change; Reanimated plate measured per cell (mirrors in RTL).

built.name: Switch
built.port: Thumb travels in 100 ms on the press curve; switch role with checked state.
built.deviations: Solid primary (black) track instead of the 21st gradient (no gradients in the Senryo look); a caller can pass a token tone.

built.name: SearchField
built.port: Inset fill, leading search glyph, clear button when not empty; search label from the shell catalogue.

built.name: FilterChips
built.port: Segmented radio chips with optional live counts; 32 pt chips; selected in ink, the rest on raised-2.

built.name: Keypad
built.port: Borderless 3 x 4 grid of large Inter figures, pressed key on row-pressed, tick per key; applyKey enforces decimals and digit caps.
built.deviations: Dialog/vaul wrapper of the 21st pad removed: the pad lives inside our sheet.

built.name: AmountPad
built.port: Figure in Roboto Condensed Black (tabular), one problem/limits line, 1/4 1/2 3/4 All chips of a balance or presets, keypad. Values in base units through viem parseUnits/formatUnits (any decimals); a chip sets the exact value, so All leaves no dust.

built.name: HoldButton
built.web: ui-web hold-to-confirm.tsx (installed 21st component) for DOM-only pages; the app's web build runs the native kit via react-native-web.
built.port: Hold 1200 ms, a tick at each quarter, linear fill, release drains; the label becomes the blocker when not ready; confirm haptic on completion.

built.name: SlideToConfirm
built.port: Native: Gesture.Pan, 56 pt rail, 48 pt thumb, commits on release past 90 %, haptic detent, chevron bends into a check, tones primary/accent/up/down, screen-reader activate action.
built.deviations: Web twin is the installed 21st component reskinned to the kit's 56 px rail, 28/22 radii and 17 px label; a locked rail is a quiet stated plate.

built.name: DisclosureRow
built.port: Title and value at rest, the detail behind one tap (the Senryo "detail behind one disclosure" rule); expanded state for assistive tech.

built.name: QuietLine

source.composedFrom: Senryo kit/QuietLine.tsx (a single meta line; nothing on 21st is smaller than a badge)

built.port: One quiet text line in text-3 under a control or figure.

built.name: ProgressBar
built.port: Spring-filled bar with progressbar semantics and a value text; reduced motion jumps.

built.name: ChangeChip
built.port: Localised signed percent on the direction's wash (up/down surface), grey when level; null draws nothing (never a fake 0 %).

built.name: ActionCircle / ActionCircles

source.composedFrom: Senryo kit/ActionCircle.tsx (the Fomo/UGLYCASH round quick action; 21st icon buttons are all ghost or square)

built.port: Round quick action with its label under it, press scale and haptic; a row of them for Send/Receive/Add money/Swap.

built.name: CountdownRing
built.port: Skia ring that drains on the UI thread toward a deadline (quote age, the next scheduled run); warn ink and a thicker stroke in the last seconds.

built.name: LiveOdometer / RollingFigure
built.port: Native: Skia picture recorded on the UI thread, direction-aware digit roll, Roboto Condensed Black from the same TTF the app embeds; masks while balances are hidden.
built.deviations: Web never loads CanvasKit: the .web twins roll with NumberFlow (21st 1444) in the display face.

built.name: Sparkline
built.port: One pure geometry (spark-geometry.ts) drawn by Skia on the phone and react-native-svg on the web: faint area, dashed baseline at the window's first price, the line in the direction ink; gaps stay gaps.

built.name: GlassPlate
built.port: iOS 26 Liquid Glass where available, the opaque glass token elsewhere and under Reduce Transparency; dock and capsule material only.

built.name: ToastHost + notify
built.port: sonner-native with one visible toast at the bottom, raised-2 plate, 20 pt corners, the dock's shadow, clears the dock; notify.success/arrived/error pair each toast with its cue.

built.name: States: Skeleton, LoadingState (shaped: line, row, list, plate, chart, hero, feed, routes, detail), PixelLoader
built.port: Skeletons shaped like the real layout, pulsing 1200 ms (static under Reduce Motion); a named wait adds the 3 x 3 pixel loader and elapsed seconds.

built.name: EmptyState
built.port: Says why in at most five words, one line of detail, and names the next action; filled group, no border.

built.name: ErrorState
built.port: Diagnosis in human words, what still works, one action (the fix or Retry), technical line behind a disclosure; strip variant for inline use.

built.name: StaleTick / OfflineStrip / ReadView
built.port: Cached values stay at full ink; a polite line says how old they are in the reader's clock; ReadView keeps children mounted between fresh and stale.

built.name: useHeldLoading / useWaitClock / WaitingText / ShimmerText
built.port: Skeleton only after 120 ms, held at least 300 ms; a short verb that shimmers, elapsed seconds after 3 s, "Still waiting · Retry" at 15 s.

built.name: BlockedCta
built.port: A blocker with a fix IS the action ("Add money", "Set a budget"); otherwise a stated quiet plate, never a grey ghost or "Soon".

built.name: TxCta
built.port: Never looks disabled in flight: the face names the phase, a phase bar fills the bottom edge (thirds), the caption says whether money moved on failure and "nothing is re-sent" while waiting.

built.name: TxSteps
built.port: Signing, Sent, Confirmed as mark + word (never colour alone); active step pulses; compact horizontal row under the CTA.

built.name: TxMorph

source.composedFrom: Mitoshi tx/TxMorph.tsx with Reanimated layout transitions (a motion wrapper with no look of its own; it morphs the CTA and the host's receipt)

built.port: The CTA fades out (160 ms) and the receipt rises in (220 ms, 60 ms late) while the box eases height (240 ms); 100 ms crossfade under Reduce Motion.

built.name: TxFailureCard
built.port: Always says whether money moved; one fix from the diagnosis, Retry when it can help, explorer link with a hash, technical details behind a disclosure.

built.name: useTxLifecycle + tx-state

source.composedFrom: Mitoshi tx/useTxLifecycle.ts and its TxState reducer (logic, no visible part)

built.port: One reducer for idle, review, blocked, signing, submitted, unknown, confirmed, failed; plays the money cue once per identity; a lost answer after the send is "unknown" and stays in the journal.

built.name: Intent journal + recovery

source.composedFrom: Senryo packages/calls intent-journal.ts and use-intent-recovery.ts (logic, no visible part); the reader lives in tx/recovery.ts

built.port: Written after the signature, before the send; mirrored to AsyncStorage; recovery only READS status by id, so nothing is ever sent twice.

built.name: Sheet / SheetHost / SheetRoute / SheetRow / SheetDrawer
built.port: Root sheet layer above every page and the dock; detents 0.62/0.88/1 (LIST_DETENTS), closes past 25 % (120 pt max) or a 900 pt/s flick, upward drag resisted /6; the page beneath steps back to 0.96; the dock hides while any sheet holds it. On a desktop window the same API is a 384 px right drawer.
built.deviations: Ported instead of @gorhom/bottom-sheet: the parent step-back and the dock hold need the host (docs pack section 6).

decisions.decision: D40 Senryo look exactly; token values changed, token names kept; four themes; testnet neutral
Web never loads CanvasKit: Skia parts have .web twins (NumberFlow, SVG)
Senryo sheet host ported instead of @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the root sheets (parent step-back, dock hold)
One app for phone and web: the native kit runs on react-native-web; a DOM twin exists only where a native library cannot (Skia) or where the 21st DOM component is the better web control (slide)

rules: 21st.dev first for every visible component; every kit part is listed here with its 21st id, or "composedFrom" where research found no match.
No hex outside packages/ui-tokens and the kit theme shim; no hard-coded strings (the shell, feedback and network catalogues).
Every surface draws loading (shaped, held), empty (why + next action), error (what still works + one action) and offline (stale-marked) states.
Every money action: BlockedCta names its fix, TxSteps, TxMorph to the receipt, TxFailureCard says whether money moved, the intent journal survives a kill and never resends.
No sound for ticks or navigation; fire() pairs haptics and cues and respects the silent switch and the person's toggles.
